sources.title: 23 January 2014: Patagonia Inc. CEO appointment
sources.findings: Joined 2008; previously CFO/COO, then CEO of parent Patagonia Works; announcement adds Patagonia Inc. presidency/CEO role. Casey Sheahan departure effective February 7, 2014. Earlier General Magic CFO and Capital Advisors roles.
sources.caution: Article body date January 23, not June URL path. Parent and subsidiary positions differ. Rivian later biography compresses Inc. CEO start to May 2013; contemporary company announcement controls. February 7 explicitly dates predecessor departure.

sources.title: 10 June 2020: departure announcement
sources.findings: President/CEO departure effective June 12, 2020; Time to Vote founded 2018; Provisions, environmental activism and internal venture fund work. Doug Freeman led transition.
sources.caution: Twelve years with company is not twelve years as CEO. June 10 announcement distinct from June 12 departure; later Ryan Gellert appointment not immediate handover. Company praise is attributed, not independent impact measurement.

sources.title: 2025 proxy: Marcario biography
sources.findings: Director since January 2021; BSc Business and Finance SUNY Albany, MBA CSU Dominguez Hills; General Magic CFO and International Rectifier global finance/treasury VP.
sources.caution: Biography section only. Age 60 not sufficient for exact birth date/year. Historical Meati appointment not automatically current. Patagonia Inc. May 2013 date conflicts with contemporary 2014 company appointment; distinguish parent role.

sources.title: 19 December 2025: director resignation filing
sources.findings: Resignation submitted December 17, effective January 1, 2026; continues as Rivian Foundation board of trustees chair.
sources.caution: Company board and independent foundation are distinct. Reason stated as other commitments; do not infer dispute or retirement.

sources.title: 3 February 2026: board election results
sources.findings: Annual member meeting announces Rose Marcario and Chuck Sams elected, Ted Philip reelected.
sources.caution: Election result, not CEO appointment. Do not infer exact service commencement or 2029 end date from announcement.

sources.title: Current board roster
sources.findings: Lists Rose Marcario director; Chris Carr chair; Mary Beth Laughton president/CEO.
sources.caution: Roster corroborates current directorship, not her physical attendance at a meeting.

sources.title: Current leadership and mission
sources.findings: Independent private foundation; Rose Marcario chair of trustees, Anisa Kamadoli Costa president.
sources.caution: Foundation chair is not chair or director of Rivian Automotive. Official photographs lack verified open reuse permission.

sources.title: 21 May 2026: conference retrospective
sources.findings: Organizer describes completed Greater Purpose Conference West and recalls conversation with Rose Marcario.
sources.caution: Publication date is not actual conversation date. Read main May article, not all dynamically appended later posts. Recent activity evidence, not a new office or measured environmental outcome.
